answer: When a submission arrives the network assigns two re-runners at random from operators who did no work that epoch, and both must reproduce the output before the receipt is written into the timber of the shared record. Rebroadcast is cheap, so the real guard is vesting, with rewards unlocking over a hundred epochs, which means a fake identity must keep answering long past the point where its operator would rather walk off the ledge. Nobody audits a recruit they invited, and that thread is public, so a farm cannot grade its own children.
